create_vecmonitor_wrapper: create a VecMonitor wrapper around a VecEnv to track episode returns and lengths
reset_vecmonitor: reset the VecMonitor wrapper and zero out episode return and length tracking arrays
step_wait_vecmonitor: step the wrapped environment and record episode info when episodes terminate
configure_results_writer: configure a VecMonitor with a filename to write episode results to a CSV file
enable_episode_buffer: enable the episode return and length buffer in VecMonitor by setting keep_buf
